item.title: County authorizes more bonds for Marin City housing project
item.description: The vote gives the developer access to more tax-exempt funding for apartments at 825 Drake Ave. as well as a nearby complex on Shoreline Highway.

item.title: Lagunitas School District voters renew parcel tax
item.description: Measure A, which needed a two-thirds majority, drew about 75% in the San Geronimo Valley.

item.title: Girls soccer: Redwood stays atop the table, clinches first-round bye
item.description: The Redwood and Tam High girls soccer teams both entered Wednesday’s showdown with dreams of potentially securing a first-round bye for next month’s MCAL playoffs and making a run at the league title in the final week of the season.

item.title: Curry helps Golden State bury Utah 140-124 behind a flurry of 3-pointers
item.description: Golden State made 23 3-pointers and never trailed over the final three quarters while racking up a season-high 140 points in Utah.

item.title: Sports Briefs: San Marin claims mat title
item.description: San Marin beat Terra Linda, then Tam in Wednesday’s tri-meet to clinch the MCAL title. The Mustangs rolled to a 65-9 victory over the Trojans in the first match of the regular-season finale.
